newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on yen's steep fall.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on yen's steep fall.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Wednesday, as the yen's steep fall against the dollar stimulated short-covering in a correction after prices had eased in recent days, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen to 1.5 yen per kg higher. Benchmark July was up 1.5 yen at 143.6 yen.

Prices gained ground, backed by a further slip in the yen, although easier Thai rubber offer prices to Japan undermined sentiment. "Despite a slight price rebound today, sentiment remained bearish amid a lack of speculative interest," one trader said.
